description: Input: the same fields as quote_faceless, plus attempt. Start a paid finished faceless video from a script or brief. You select 30–90 seconds; the video ends with its narration, runs at least 25 seconds and at most a quarter past the selection, never beyond 90. The video has an opening animated clip and image scenes. Captions are on by default and can be turned off. Call quote_faceless first and show the user the price. This does NOT wait for the video: it starts the run and returns a run_id IMMEDIATELY. Then call get_run with its poll.arguments until the state is 'succeeded' (video_url) or 'failed'. Pass attempt=2,3,… to deliberately start a NEW run for the same input. Price: generated picture 7 credits per image plus opening clip 49 credits per clip plus production (story, voice and render) 1 credits per second of video, at least 50. Quote first with quote_faceless; list_prices names every price.
name: make_faceless
title: Make a faceless video
